feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 September 2026 4:29pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 08 September 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Scotland with weak fronts and troughs affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first mainly in the east and north of the area, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then decreasing 2 to 4 in the afternoon, and gradually backing west or southwest.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough later this evening and at first tonight in the north and east of the area, then becoming slight by tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest, backing south or southwest, 2 to 4, then increasing 3 to 5 overnight into Thursday. Then becoming south 5 or 6 Thursday morning, occasionally increasing 7 in places on Thursday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate Thursday morning, occasionally increasing rough in west and central areas Thursday afternoon.


##Weather##

Rain approaching from the west on Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
